notes: Models in tabs: open several models in one window; Ctrl+N asks the units and starts a model in a new tab; a model double-clicked while Akar runs opens in a new tab. One Import (the file type decides; a DWG asks whether to make 3D from it or bring it in as a drawing) and one Export. Scene tabs and Model/sheet tabs sit above and below the view; less empty space around the view. Plotted PDFs carry the real fonts; font lists show each font in its own face. Section fill materials in collapsible collections. Round Corners and Fillet have their own icons; the pointer shows Orbit or Pan while the view is moved. The Environments panel is gone (Shadows sets the sun and sky). File types by their extensions.
